title: SharePoint: Copilot in SharePoint, with advanced work billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing, billing prerequisites, site controls and retirement date are supported by Microsoft's documentation and notice. Minor corrections should clarify the credit-warning threshold, acknowledge conflicting site-creation documentation and identify the spending-policy control missing from the table.

Add Identity-based spending policy

Use this option when you want a policy to apply to the people who use selected agents and services.
